description: This project links creditors (or investors) looking for projects to invest in, and debtors who have promising projects. From the platform, a debtor can submit his project filling in details about the project, and the total budget. On the other hands, creditors can inject a certain amount of money and get profits at the end of the refunding cycle. Everything happens on chain with an AI tool to validate projects and assign a rentability score.
how_its_made:
We used cairo and starknet to build the smart contract, and next.js for the frontend. We also used  Dynamic to allow users to connect to the platform using their web3 wallet.
Some work still need to be done, but for now we have UIs ready and smart contract without proper calculations
We are also planning to add an AI model for validation and KYC verification
